title: Rate-limited fetch queue (complex bed)
prompt:
Build a small TypeScript module system in the current directory:

1. src/rate-limiter.ts — a token-bucket rate limiter: `createRateLimiter({ capacity, refillPerSecond, now })` returning `{ tryAcquire(): boolean, waitMs(): number }`. `now` is an injected clock (ms) so tests are deterministic. waitMs() returns 0 when a token is available, otherwise the ms until the next token.

2. src/retry.ts — `computeBackoffMs(attempt, { baseMs, maxMs, jitterRatio, random })`: exponential backoff with injectable `random` for deterministic jitter; attempt 1 => baseMs. Also `shouldRetry(status: number): boolean` — true for 429 and 5xx, false otherwise.

3. src/fetch-queue.ts — `createFetchQueue({ limiter, fetchImpl, maxConcurrent, maxAttempts, backoff, now, setTimeoutImpl })` returning `{ enqueue(url): Promise<{ url, status, attempts }>, size(): number }`. It must: respect maxConcurrent in-flight requests, acquire a limiter token before each attempt, retry on shouldRetry statuses with the backoff schedule up to maxAttempts, and settle each enqueue promise with the final outcome (never reject on HTTP failure — resolve with the last status).

4. test/rate-limiter.test.ts, test/retry.test.ts, test/fetch-queue.test.ts — node:test + node:assert/strict, all clocks/random/fetch injected (no real timers, no network). fetch-queue tests must include an INTEGRATION case: 5 URLs through capacity-2 limiter with maxConcurrent 2 where two URLs 429 once then succeed — assert total attempts, per-URL attempts, and that concurrency never exceeded 2 (instrument fetchImpl).

Run the tests with `node --test` (this Node runs .ts natively — do NOT use npx or install anything; the sandbox has no network) and make them all pass.

Acceptance command: node --test test/rate-limiter.test.ts test/retry.test.ts test/fetch-queue.test.ts
specification: Rate-limited fetch queue (complex bed) — the prompt is self-contained; build exactly what it asks in the current directory. Acceptance: `node --test test/rate-limiter.test.ts test/retry.test.ts test/fetch-queue.test.ts`.
